_comment: Source script for tools/generate_voices.py. Keys under each tone MUST match the LINES keys in js/main.js (any key without a clip falls back to phone TTS). Distances stay qualitative so lines can be pre-recorded. Voice character tags are applied ONLY to that voice's anchor clip; every later clip clones the anchor, so the tag text can never bleed into normal lines.

start: Alright, Aida. Streets are clear, the dead are asleep. Try not to wake them. Off you go.
Morning. Statistically, most of them are still where you left them. Enjoy the warm-up while it lasts.
spawn: Company behind you. Not close yet. They seem motivated, though. Pity.
Something's noticed you. It's picking up the pace. Rude, really.
ambush: Oh, that's a lot of them. Sprinters. Right behind you. Do the running thing. Now.
Ambush. They skipped the small talk. Aida, I'd move if I were you.
gap90: Ninety meters and gaining. Slowly. Embarrassing for everyone involved.
They're closing. Ninety meters. Plenty of time to panic efficiently.
gap60: Sixty meters. This would be an excellent time to actually try.
Sixty meters. I'm not saying hurry, but. Hurry.
gap30: Thirty meters. I'd run if I were you. I'm not. You are. Run.
Thirty meters. They can basically read your race number. Go.
close: That's close enough to smell them. You won't enjoy it. Move.
They're practically wearing you as a scarf. Kick.
escapeOutran: And they're gone. Turns out cardio pays off. Who knew. Well run, Aida.
You lost them. Somewhere back there they're deeply disappointed. Beautiful.
escapeTired: They've given up. Slumped in the road, like my expectations. You're clear.
And they quit. Dead, and still lazy. Off you go.
bitten: Well, that'll leave a mark. You're fine. Probably. Keep moving.
They got a nibble. Rude. Walk it off, Aida. Briskly. Very briskly.
overrun: That's the horde, then. For what it's worth, you outran my expectations. Stroll home.
They got you. Anticlimactic, honestly. Head home, hero.
km: Another kilometer. The dead are keeping score. So am I.
That's another one down. Nobody's impressed. But well done.
finish: Home. Still breathing. Statistically remarkable. Let's see the damage.
You made it, Aida. I had money on the zombies. Pulling up the report.
armorSave: Your armor took that one. Expensive way to avoid a bruise. Keep going.
flare: Flare's up. They're terrified of fire. Frankly, so am I. Go.
bait: Bait's down. They're fighting over it like a free sample stand. Move.
rankUp: Look at that. A promotion. There's no pay, obviously.

start: Dispatch online. The area is clear. Begin your run, Aida.
Comms check, good. No contacts on the board. Start when you're ready.
spawn: Contact behind you. Distance is comfortable. Maintain your pace.
One group has your trail. No action needed yet. Keep it steady.
ambush: Multiple contacts, close range. Sprinters. Increase pace now.
Ambush, directly behind you. Go to a sprint. Now.
gap90: Ninety meters and closing. Lift the pace.
Gap is ninety meters. Steady increase, please.
close: They are on you. Maximum effort.
escapeOutran: Distance is opening. You've lost them. Good work.
Gap confirmed clear. Well executed. Ease back when you're ready.
escapeTired: Contacts have stopped pursuing. You're clear.
They've broken off. You're clear. Recover your breathing.
bitten: You've been hit. Injury logged. Keep moving.
Contact made. You're still mobile. Continue.
overrun: You're overrun. Disengage and head home. The run is logged.
That's the end of the pursuit. Walk it in. You did well to last.
km: Another kilometer logged. Your pace is good.
finish: Run complete. You're safe. Compiling your report.
Copy that, you're home. Report incoming.
armorSave: Armor absorbed that hit. No injury. Continue.
bait: Bait deployed. Contacts diverting. You're clear to run.
rankUp: Rank increase confirmed. New equipment is available.
